tei:div.tei:p: 571) kyai// bdag ni rig 'dzin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// dam la gnas shing tshul bzhin sgrub lags na// srung ma dam la mi gnas srid lags sam// dgongs shig brgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde tshogs rnams// sngon tshe ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi bka'// bar du mkhan slob chos rgyal lo paṇa lung*// tha ma rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab sogs// bka' gter rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tha tshig la// gnas pa'i dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag// ma ning nag po sngags srung e ka dzaḥ gza' bdud chen po dam can rdor legs sogs// chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// chos 'khor 'di yi bstan pa sde dang bcas/ khyod la gtad pa yin par ma dran nam// sa ma ya yi dus la da bab pas// mthu rtsal nus pa'i dpung shugs da bskyed la// dpal yul ba yi bstan pa rin 572) po che// yar zla ji bzhin gong nas gong 'phel du// bshad sgrub dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas pa yi// phrin las sdong grogs ma g.yel sa ma ya/ gal brgyud gsum bla ma'i g.yar dam las// 'das nas phrin las ci bcol ma sgrub na// brgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde tshogs thams cad kyi// mgo bo tshal pa stong du 'gas par 'gyur// de bas chos 'khor 'dis mtshon snga 'gyur ba'i// bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung zhing skyob pa dang*/ zhi sogs rab 'byams phrin las gang bcol ba/ g.yol med myur du sgrub par mdzad du gsol//
zhes pa'ang 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros kyis bris pa dge/ maṅga laṃ/
